title: Autonomous Cyber-Physical Telemetry and Enthalpy Optimization in Smackover DLE Formations
author: healthearthack
abstract: We present the operational validation of autonomous cyber-physical telemetry co-located with Direct Lithium Extraction (DLE) and binary-cycle Organic Rankine geothermal recovery in Smackover formation wellbores. The system generates 1.95 MWe of surplus electricity (EROI = 4.05) and achieves a net-negative lifecycle carbon delta of -14.82 kg CO2e/kg LCE. Downhole multiphase hydraulics are secured via NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 Navier-Stokes invariants precluding Modbus sensor spoofing. Statutory evaluation under IRA Section 45X confirms $4,424,532.00 USD annual production credits, while an algorithmic Waqf civic trust dedicates $3,160,000.00 USD annually to regional clean water distillation and veteran transition.
